tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and notes support multiple plausible stationary mechanisms, while the five rows sample only s_grad up to 2.2 and hold other inputs fixed. An open-branch discriminating observation is the most relevant available low-cost probe to resolve that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: author a smooth stationary model now (e.g. Cobb–Douglas or concave base-field plus sink-gradient)
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations vary u_now and s_grad but do not resolve the competing response structures or establish behavior on the open branch; fitting now risks failing fresh confirmation.
Current evidence suggests structural ambiguity, not inadequate sampling resolution along a known trajectory.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the target law.
